title: Base 7
description:
Given an integer num , return a string of its base 7 representation . 

 Example 1: 
 
```
Input:
 num = 100

Output:
 "202"
```
 
 Example 2: 
 
```
Input:
 num = -7

Output:
 "-10"
```

 Constraints: 

 -10 7 <= num <= 10 7
